items.title: Johnny DeDroit Interview, 1969-12-04
items.q: And one of my ex saxophonists who was part of my success came to town and the unionist had phone me first to ask me if I would let them give Rudolph Levy my phone number.

ctx.x: It might be a friend trying to get me. It might be a friend from out of town who wants to pay me a visit. My phone, as long as my wife was sick, no one knew my phone number. And one of my ex saxophonists who was part of my success came to town and the unionist had phone me first to ask me if I would let them give Rudolph Levy my phone number. I said, sure, give it to Rudolph. So I went to visit him. He stopped at the term mountain. We had chinchin for hours over. I don't know what his wife thought about him. He…
